newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Cetes rate ends down on stable peso.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Cetes rate ends down on stable peso.

text.p: Mexican overnight Cetes rates declined 10 basis points to close at 20.00 percent on Monday due to a stable peso, dealers said.
"We saw more dollars in supply and that helped rates to slide," a fixed-income analyst said.
Benchmark 48-hour peso contracts meanwhile closed 0.8 of a centavo firmer at 7.9450/7.9500 per dollar.
The analyst said secondary market rates may also be anticipating mild U.S. consumer data due early on Tuesday.
"They may have moved ahead of signs (U.S.) inflation is under control," he said.
